findings.evidence: ## When to use restates the frontmatter: "When a run, a review or an execution step calls an external AI CLI and acts on the result."
findings.fix: Delete the When to use section; trigger text belongs only in the description.

findings.evidence: ## What a skill does on a stop repeats SKILL.md sections 6-8: "print the cross-ai: report ... one one-shot wait ... Never switch harness, provider or model."
findings.fix: Replace that section with a one-line pointer to SKILL.md sections 6-8 and drop the restated caller rules.

findings.evidence: ## 5. Chain review or execution is three sentences: "Chain the next step only after section 4 has been read. A lane that is still running is not chained."
findings.fix: Name the two outcomes (review report to merge vs execution change to verify) and the single gate (lane.rc plus last AIKIT-XAI line already read) so the chain step is a procedure, not a reminder.

findings.evidence: ## Pitfalls lists facts ("No idle watchdog. stdout +0 bytes heartbeats are normal for pi -p") but has no Gotchas heading and no WHY on the process-name stop or the atomic-rewrite mode drop.
findings.fix: Rename Pitfalls to Gotchas and add the non-obvious reason on each item: a process-name kill can hit a sibling lane, and a hand rewrite of a 0600 state file drops the mode the runner set.

findings.evidence: Description covers WHAT, WHEN and keywords (cross-ai.mjs, AIKIT-XAI, exit 75/69, retry_after_s=) but omits Claude Code as a host and exit 124, and "answer a stop" is vague.
findings.fix: Use when you run, wait for, read, retry or chain an external AI CLI (pi, opencode, codex, cursor, copilot) from Claude Code or any other host through ai-kit's cross-AI runner (cross-ai.mjs): pick one runtime and model, launch the runner, read its exit code (0, 1, 2, 69, 75, 124, 127) and last AIKIT-XAI stderr line, and answer GSD retry or abort. Also use when a lane hits quota, a rate limit or a 429, or prints retry_after_s=. Covers the hard-tier one-shot wait, the user notice and the rule to never switch harness, provider or model. Not for reviewer setup or GSD config (those are ai-kit-spec-config and ai-kit-gsd-curated-config).

findings.evidence: The mandatory first-launch read of launch-and-wait.md loads six near-duplicate host sections (pi, opencode, cursor, codex, copilot, and the fallback), each saying only "unverified" and "foreground wait".
findings.fix: Keep the Claude Code section and one fallback section; replace the five host headings with one line: "pi, opencode, cursor, codex and copilot are unverified and use the fallback. Do NOT Load a per-host section for them."

findings.evidence: The hard-tier scheduler is a menu of equal uncertainty: "Where Claude Code's CronCreate is callable, schedule one one-shot job ... A retry_after_s under 60 s, a session where that tool is unavailable ... and every other host (none is known to have a one-shot scheduler; unverified) schedule nothing."
findings.fix: Default every host, including Claude Code, to print retry_after_s, the state path and the re-invoke command and stop. Mention CronCreate only as an escape hatch when the tool is already callable and retry_after_s is at least 60 s, rounding up to the next whole minute.

findings.evidence: No evals/ directory: no evals/evals.json and no evals/trigger-queries.json. The skill ships no runnable script, so the 8/7 split applies; tests/test_cross_ai_skill_text.py and tests/test_quota_policy_text.py are text pins and are not scored.
findings.fix: Add evals/evals.json with at least three realistic prompts (a clean exit 0, an exit 75 with retry_after_s=, a bare 75 or stopped=hard-waits) plus verifiable assertions, and evals/trigger-queries.json with about 20 queries, 8-10 should-trigger and 8-10 should-not-trigger, including near-misses for reviewer setup and GSD config.

findings.evidence: The exit table ends at 127; the next sentence says "128+n | signal | the child died on signal n" with no caller action, and section 7's abort list ("a bare 75, any 69 ... 1, 2, 124, 127") omits 128+n.
findings.fix: Add a table row: 128+n, signal, report the signal and abort. Add 128+n to the section 7 abort list so a signaled child is not left unclassified.

findings.evidence: "Before the first launch ... check the active copy's line-2 header (sed -n 2p ...) ... A lower template, or a cross-ai.mjs.new waiting beside it, is not this contract: stop and route the owner to ai-kit-gsd-curated-config ensure-runner." A missing file or a header without template= has no branch.
findings.fix: If the project copy is missing, use the template path and still require template=8. If line 2 has no template= token, treat it as below template 8 and stop the same way.
